changes: The lyrics customization options are no longer centered individually.
You can no longer press enter to cancel downloading a map.
The loading game menu now appears instantly without the smooth appearing animation.
The failed to load the map error menu now appears smoothly.
Menus appearing right after another menu has disappeared no longer cause the screen-wide background to reappear with the animation.
Replaced most checkboxes with switches and moved them to the left of the text which also is now aligned to the left.
Fixed being able to input a space inside a word.
The map WPM is now calculated based on the length of verses instead of the map length without marked lyricless parts.
WPM numbers now have colors, the more green the color the lower the number, the more red the higher.
You can now press backspace in an empty in-game input or at the start of one with a word to go to the previous one.
You can now move between the word inputs using arrow keys.
Non-stacked menus now appear smoothly instead of instantly.
Added an animation for menu buttons making them slide from the right, and the song list information appearing smoothly.
Added a text that says "No highscore on those settings yet." that's there if you have saving highscores enabled to make the menu not change height.
The speed selector is now a slider.
On-off settings in the general section are no longer centered individually.
The Lyrhythmics logo in the corner of the main menu is now a button that leads to the main menu.
Added information about the order of the importance of changes to the top of the changelog page.
Autospace and Free verse changing on the map customization menu no longer have more information visible but instead a ? button.
Added an option to include the background image from the theme in the map or force the default background.
On-off settings are now slightly grayed out when disabled and the cursor changes to pointer when hovering over them.
The default map customization part of the settings is now more compact like on the usual map customization menu.
Removed colons from the start of setting headers.
The color of the length text on level buttons is now brighter.
The map customization menu now has a horizontal line around the Settings header.
The highscore on those settings text is no longer there if you change the restart settings before continuing with them.
Removed the | and the small text right padding and switched the places of map length and WPM on level buttons.
The remove buttons in the editor now use the same icon as the menu close button instead of the X character.
The warning menus in the editor now have pink headers, more space between the lines and the removed verse is in quotation marks.
Replaced the "Input the edited verse" text with a pink header that says "Verse editing".
The this map has (time) without lyrics text is now themed like the description of a setting.
The close button in the corner of some menus no longer has backdrop blur to not hide text and its icon is styled like the fullscreen button's one.
Fixed pressing enter right in the about menu reopening it instantly after closing it.
You can no longer press enter to close the settings menu.
Fixed main menu buttons with one line of text being in an animation loop if you left the mouse slightly above them and the menu had a scrollbar.
The itch.io and Newgrounds versions now appear at 705px height by default instead of 675px to make the new map customization menus fit.
Now on maps that don't have parts without lyrics but have lyrics customization options, start time is the setting that's the only one horizontally.
The this map skips a part of the song text shown on maps with force-skip is now among the highscore and the map description instead of the bottom.
Shortened the description of the Force outline setting.
Added a custom focus visible style.
Fixed some elements in the editor settings being indexable via tab with a warning menu visible.
The fullscreen icon on the optional fullscreen button now becomes white on hover smoothly.
Added free verse changing, a setting which lets you type any verse anytime except of during marked lyricless parts.
Menus now have a background that covers just them and is more blurred and darker. The whole-screen darkening is now more transparent.
Added a close button to the corner of the changelog, about, automap and settings menus.
The map customization menu is now more compact.
The placeholders of inputs that are at the top of the screen when playing now are the color of typed text at 50% opacity making them more readable.
Checking for a word being typed late now happens while you type instead of just when the next word passes.
Added a loading screen which is shown before the game finishes loading as well as a failed to load game screen.
Added percentages to the total column of the statistics table on the menu shown when you finish a map.
Improved background change lag prevention, it now only activates itself if the lag is when a background change starts for the first time in the map.
If you change the lyrics customization while typing the next verse early, the change no longer applies to the typed verse.
If you change the lyrics customization while inside a lyricless part, it now applies to the verse after it unless you started typing that verse early.
The buttons in the top right corner of the editor no longer cover the Map settings text on smaller resolutions.
The optional fullscreen button icon is now a bit thinner.
Now there's a bit more space between the cancel button and the loading map text as well as between the paused text and the map name.
Replaced the text that said "An error occured while loading the" with "Failed to load the".
The warning text and the new text that says "Failed to load the" are now proper headers instead of just being bold text.
Changed punctuation and formatting of the text that says "otherwise the theme default will be used" on the automap page to now be in brackets.
Replaced "except of" with "except for" on the about and automap pages.
When you replace the song in automap or in the editor the time on the player is reset to 0 seconds.
The mobile warning for the editor is now also shown when you attempt to edit a map.
Improved the tab hitbox of the buttons at the right side of the main menu.
Fixed a bug that caused the song to desync sometimes after continuing with restart settings.
Fixed themes not being saved after being changed after being reset to default.
Fixed audio bugs caused by using 3rd party pause and unpause for audio mostly when you were not expected to do it.
Fixed the continue with restart settings checkmark sometimes still being there after changing lyrics customization to what it was before pausing.
Fixed the default background image instead of information about it being the default one being stored in the theme if you reset it to default.
Fixed pressing enter closing both the failed to load the theme error and the settings menu at once.
Fixed the texts that say "Loading song..." and "Failed to load song." not being centered on the automap page.
Optimised the performance of menu background lyrics.
Updated the license of the song DJStriden - Light The World Pt II as it was changed to Creative Commons.
Added three officially mapped songs: "DJStriden - Light The World Pt II", "MTSsmitty - Wings of Goodbye" and "Cloudier - A Centimetre Apart".
Highscores are now seperated by autospace like by every other setting from the map customization menu. Highscores from before this update are unaffected.
The song list is no longer at the top of the screen when it doesn't take the entire height of it.
The text next to the checkbox to include hue-rotate in the map on the automap page is now centered when it's split into multiple lines.
Fixed inputting a space into a word input if you pressed space the moment you loaded a map.
Fixed not being able to continue with restart settings if you enabled autospace while no lyrics were visible.
Fixed being able to stretch a background filter in the map editor into a slightly negative time, as well as onto the previous background filter if the stretched one ended when the next one started.
Added theming. You can access it in the settings.
The score visible in the corner of the screen when playing is now always rounded to the lower number.
Added a setting to disable rounding of the score to a full number when playing.
The selected speed color in the speed selector is now a mix of two standard colors instead of a unique one.
The additional info textarea input in the map editor settings is now styled like other textareas.
Added information about customizing input colors as an alternative to the "Additional word correctness feedback" setting to the about page.

The information about settings being saved in local storage is now at the top of the settings menu instead of the bottom of it and has been reworded a bit because when you change a theme setting the entire theme gets saved.
Fixed autospace not working if you started typing a verse early and the previous one hasn't passed yet.

When you enable autospace from the pause menu and continue with the settings, the currently sang word gets selected. When you started typing a verse early and did that before the previous verse passed, the word with the index of the length of the previous verse was selected, that's fixed now.
Fixed not being able to go to a further word than the length of the previous verse if you started typing a verse early and the previous one hasn't passed yet.
Fixed pausing desyncing the song a lot if the speed isn't set to 1. This bug was introduced with a 1.4.2 bugfix.
Changed the way pressing space to go to the next word is handled as the previous one didn't work on some mobile browsers.
The moving words now have less horizontal padding on mobile so they don't have to be split into as many lines as before.
Disabled autocorrect and autocapitalize in the word inputs. Autocapitalize made the first letter of each word capitalized on some mobile browsers.
Added a setting to disable background filters due to them causing huge lag on some devices and browsers.
Now if the FPS drop to 5 or less during a background transition, a warning pop ups and background changes get disabled for that map.
Added a setting called "Disable lag prevention" which disables checking for what is described in the previous change.
You can now hold the buttons in the song list on mobile to listen to the song samples.
Fixed song samples playing in the map customization menu if you're on the mobile UI by having a low width screen but not on a mobile device.
Fixed the game pausing and unpausing itself endlessly if you restart the map and start typing almost at once.
Fixed pausing slightly desyncing the song.
Fixed the optional fullscreen button that's on Newgrounds and itch.io overlapping the mobile pause button.
Now the fullscreen button isn't there if the game starts in fullscreen mode, which is the case for itch.io on mobile.
The mobile start and pause buttons now have tabindex set, meaning they aren't accessible through pressing tab when there's an overlay.
Made it so you can go to the next verse if the last word of the current one is being sang and the next verse is visible on the screen.
Adapted the game for mobile devices, excluding the editor which would be hard to adapt.
The right margin of the score and time panel that's in the top right corner when playing is now the same as the top one.
Added information about going to the next verse to the about page.
Moved the mobile warning screen to when you try to open the editor on mobile and made it just say that the editor doesn't work well on mobile.
The restart button in the pause menu normally has a right margin to make the middle button more at the center, now if the download button is there it no longer has it.

Added a setting to reduce background transparency which makes it easier to read the text. It also adds an outline to the texts in inputs in the playing view to make them readable when the inputs have bright non-transparent background colors.
The highscore disable screen now has the same background opacity as all the other screens.
Perfect Shade - Reaching High is now saved in constant bitrate fixing slight desync issues, the timings of verses have also been adapted to this.
Added an option to continue playing with the selected restart settings, highscores are disabled with it. Also added a setting to enable it by default.
Automap now automatically adds parts without lyrics if you don't specify any and use a file which has lyricless parts that are at least 8 seconds long.
Now when you export/download a map that uses the default background image, the background image data will not be saved in the file.
If a lyricless part which is added to automap in text mode starts at 0:00, it no longer is shortened by 1 second at the start.
Updated the automap section of the about page to mention the new automap parts without lyrics from file being 2 seconds shorter too.
Fixed the information on the song list page always being moved up like if the fullscreen button was there in the version on my website.
Fixed a typo in the first word of the about page. Lyrythmics -> Lyrhythmics
Changed the code a bit to make dynamic map loading work on Newgrounds and itch.io, decreasing initial loading time by a lot.
The darkening and blur effect behind menus now has a higher opacity to make it easier to read the text in the menu.
Now when a .lrc file provides the information on who made the file, automap sets the map author to "Automap (.lrc by author)".

Automap now sets the song name to just the provided title if there's no information on who made it or if the provided title contains " - ", which means that it most likely already contains the creator.
The itch.io version now uses the in-game fullscreen button instead of itch.io's built-in one.
The fullscreen button that's on Newgrounds and now itch.io is no longer on top of the text in the song list.
The hover title of the fullscreen button now has a full stop at the end of it.
Added autospace, a setting which automatically moves you to the next word when you type a word correctly or the current word passes.
Added a setting that makes the pitch in songs change along with the speed.
The map customization and end screens now have a download map button if the map was generated by automap.
Now when a .lrc file provides the title and information on who made the song, automap sets the song name to that instead of the audio file name.
Ł and Ø are now properly replaced when accent letters are disabled.
When you use the arrows to change the number in the custom speed input, it now gets changed by 0.125 instead of 1.
Removed 2 and 0.375 from the list of suggested speeds, added 1.375 and 0.625 instead.
Grouped the main settings into two categories, general and default map customization.
Renamed Editor settings to Editor/playtesting settings.
Changed the order of some settings.
Added horizontal lines to the left and right sides of setting categories and removed the colon.
Song samples in the main menu are now played at the speed configured in the default speed setting.
Changed the look of the optional fullscreen button that's on Newgrounds and made it so it's always there instead of just in the main menu.
Added a setting to hide the fullscreen button, it's only there if the variant of the game has the fullscreen button enabled.

Updated the press any key to start message which appears when you start in a lyricless part. The "a" before a number is now replaced with "an" when necessary, when the part isn't added to the lyricless parts list it now says it's unmarked instead of short, the text for it not being skipped is new and the time until the end of the unmarked lyricless part or its length is now displayed.
Added information on how to see the changelog to the about page.
The information on the about page regarding pressing escape making you leave fullscreen is now there in the itch.io version as well.
Fixed the playtest button disable happening also in the settings menu.
Text in the changelog now has a maximum width, it's the same as on the about page.
All alternative texts for images now start with a uppercase letter, also fixed one occurance of "Background image" instead of "Background".
Added .srt, .vtt and .lrc file support. They can be uploaded in automap and in the map editor.
Added the word length limit setting. It allows you to limit the amount of letters in each word.
The main menu background lyrics are now only visible if no menu is open.
Updated the text on the automap page, in the automap and editor sections of the about page, as well as in the corner of the song list.
Changed the error message for trying to upload a non-JSON file to load map.
Replaced the text that says "Ok" on a button in the add lyrics menu in the editor with "Add".
Added an optional fullscreen button to the main menu, it's enabled in the Newgrounds version.
Made it so the playtest button is disabled if your scroll position is after the end of the lyrics.
When opening the map editor by creating a new map, the speed is now set to the value of the default speed setting instead of 1.
Fixed the hover title on the add lyrics button that says "Input the lyrics first." not being there if you input just spaces or enters.
Fixed negative start time upper limit when the map is shorter than 0.1 seconds and length not being displayed if the map is 0 seconds long.
Improved the code a bit, most notably replaced sections with divs.
Fixed a typo on the about page. Hovewer -> However
Fixed text not being centered in the changelog if there's more than one version.
The version in the corner of the main menu is now loaded from the changelog.json file.
Initial release.
